feeds.title: Euthanasia Prevention Coalition
feeds.description: Euthanasia Prevention Coalition is a blog about euthanasia, assisted suicide, elder abuse, end-of-life care, palliative care. Most recent articles and news from around the world.

feeds.title: Reject Assisted Suicide NZ
feeds.description: Reject Assisted Suicide NZ is a program of Family First NZ. Our goal is to stop the legalisation of assisted suicide in New Zealand because if assisted suicide (euthanasia) is legalised, it would place large numbers of vulnerable Kiwis at risk.

feeds.title: Impact Ethics » Death & Assisted Dying
feeds.description: Impact Ethics gives information about bioethical issues. Get the latest news and updates about Death & Assisted Dying at Impact Ethics.

feeds.title: DyingForChoice.com
feeds.description: DyingForChoice.com is dedicated to responsible assisted dying law reform. We provide up-to-date and evidence-backed information for the general public, policy makers, healthcare workers, researchers, media and others.

feeds.title: Euthanasia Debate
feeds.description: Get the information on the End of Life Choice Act, euthanasia, assisted suicide, and assisted dying. We facilitate discussion about the risks, societal implications and unintended consequences of euthanasia and assisted suicide legislation.

feeds.title: Dying With Dignity Canada
feeds.description: Dying With Dignity Canada is the national not-for-profit organization committed to improving quality of dying, protecting end-of-life rights, and helping Canadians avoid unwanted suffering. Read the latest news and insights related to your end-of-life rights and choices.
